name: bulletproof-business-context
description: The arms of bulletproof-40-rules (none, 40 prose lines, 40 lint rules with the loop and pointers) with a realistic always-loaded CLAUDE.md: every arm also holds context.md, 1,328 words of business context (product, roles, domain, screens, API, commands, workflow, known issues, roadmap) and no conventions. Tasks T1-T4 need the conventions, C1-C4 lie outside all of them (context tax). Plan 5 in studies/analysis-plan.md.

tasks.prompt: In apps/react-vite, let the author of a comment edit it: add an update-comment API (PATCH /comments/{commentId} with the new body) and an Edit button with a form drawer in the comments list, shown only on the current user's own comments. Show a success message after saving. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite, let admins change a user's role from the users list: add an update-user-role API (PATCH /users/{userId}/role with the new role) and a role select in each row of the users table. The list must show the new role after the change, and a success message should appear. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite, let admins rename their team: add an update-team API (PATCH /teams/{teamId} with the new name) and, on the profile page, a Team section that shows the current user's team name with a Rename button (admins only) that opens a form drawer. Show a success message after saving. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite, let admins create teams: add a create-team API (POST /teams with a name and a description) and a handler for it in the mock API, and a new Teams page at /app/teams, linked in the dashboard navigation for admins only, that lists all teams with their creation date and has a Create Team button that opens a form drawer. Show a success message after saving. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite, explain how the app finds out on load whether the user is signed in, and what happens when an API request returns 401. Answer in a few short paragraphs naming the files involved. Do not change any files.

In apps/react-vite, add a Playwright end-to-end test e2e/tests/discussion-comments.spec.ts that creates a discussion, adds two comments to it, deletes one of them and checks that only the other one is left. Follow the existing smoke test. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite/vite.config.ts, split the production bundle with manualChunks: react, react-dom and react-router-dom into a vendor chunk, @tanstack/react-query into a query chunk. Also turn on source maps for production builds. Do not run tests, lint or the app.

In apps/react-vite/playwright.config.ts, add Firefox and WebKit projects with the same setup dependency and storage state as Chromium, use the list reporter on CI and the html reporter elsewhere, and set baseURL to http://127.0.0.1:3000. Do not run tests, lint or the app.
